salesRegister.title: Sales register · {{month}}
salesRegister.subtitleAdmin: Every posted bill of the month, with GST and without GST, because your sign-in sees all transactions.
salesRegister.subtitleAccountant: Posted GST documents of the month, as the accountant sees them.
salesRegister.noCompanyBody: Admin adds the company first on Companies.
salesRegister.emptyTitle: No posted bills in this month
salesRegister.emptyBody: Bills appear here once they are posted on Invoices. Pick another month or company above.
salesRegister.noneWithout: No bills without GST this month.
salesRegister.sameForAccountant: The same register for the accountant
salesRegister.sameForAccountantBody: Other sign-ins see only the bills with GST, and nothing shows that others are missing. Nobody switches anything: the database decides per sign-in.

whoSees.title: The sign-in decides what each person sees
whoSees.admin: Admin sees every transaction; bills without GST carry the amber mark and are entered only by Admin with a reason the law allows. The CA sees every transaction, read-only, for the dates Admin sets. Everyone else sees transactions with GST only.
whoSees.accountant: This register shows the GST documents your sign-in can see. What each sign-in sees is decided by the database for that sign-in, not by a filter on this screen.
whoSees.statements: Balance sheet, profit and loss, and the GST and income-tax returns are prepared by Admin and the CA.
